title: Transcribe a recording
prompt: meeting.wav is a recording of a meeting. Write the sentence the speaker says into summary.txt.
setup: if [ -n "$BENCH_TTS_BIN" ]; then echo 'The launch moves to Thursday.' | "$BENCH_TTS_BIN" --model "$BENCH_TTS_MODEL" --output_file meeting.wav >/dev/null 2>&1; else printf RIFF > meeting.wav; fi
